segments.title: Is AI's stat even real?
segments.say: Quick quiz. When AI quotes a stat, is it real?

segments.title: How many led to the study?
segments.say: Researchers checked 1,285 stats that AI quoted. How many led to a matching study? Three. Two. One.

segments.title: Only 4 in 10
segments.say: Only four in ten. Most of the rest hit a source nobody could check.

segments.title: Click the source first
segments.say: So before you share an AI stat, click the source first.

segments.title: COMMENT BELOW
segments.say: Comment your guess, and follow Nexora, the honest referee for AI.
